artist.paragraph2: From timeless beauty to bolder creations, every work starts with the same idea: enhancing identity, never hiding it.

reviews.eyebrow: Words from those who experienced it
reviews.title: Beauty is seen.

items.natalia: Bruno takes the time to understand you and advise you on the best option, always adapting to your style and personality. He is approachable, cheerful and a true artist. I never tire of recommending him.
items.lorena: As a Black woman, one of my biggest concerns was finding a professional who truly knew how to work with my skin tone. Bruno matched the shade perfectly, enhanced my skin without changing its colour and created beautiful makeup designed for me. As well as being extremely attentive, he is a professional who knows how to work with different skin tones and types.
items.gabriela: For my wedding at the Sagrada Família, I chose Bruno to do my makeup. He understood my dream with great professionalism and care, doing everything to a high standard and always using the best products.
items.maria: Although I am very indecisive, Bruno and I understood each other very well and found the makeup that made me feel comfortable and beautiful for my wedding. He was very kind throughout the process. I recommend him without hesitation.
items.aline: Bruno was polite, kind and made it easy for me to trust his work. It was a dream come true and he was part of it. I will always remember that day and, of course, the sensitivity he showed me.
items.lolys: I could not have chosen a better makeup artist for my wedding day. He captured exactly what I wanted and made me feel beautiful and very comfortable all day. A great professional, approachable and attentive.

manifesto.title: More than
manifesto.paragraph1: For Bruno, makeup is not about hiding someone or turning them into someone else. It is about understanding who is in front of him and creating from there.
manifesto.paragraph2: Every face, occasion and project calls for a different approach — always respecting each person's personality, style and individuality.

journey.title: A journey
journey.paragraph1: With more than eight years of experience in the world of beauty, Bruno Mënezess has built a career defined by versatility and attention to detail.
journey.paragraph2: Today, in Barcelona, his work spans different contexts — from personal moments and celebrations to creative, editorial and professional productions.

approach.title: Every work
approach.description: Listening, technique and sensitivity to create a result that works in the mirror, on camera or in a room full of people — without hiding the person behind the makeup.
